metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct safety_rule for Spring Boot 3.0 system requirements verification with no semantic overlap to existing skills (Virtual WAN routing, Flink buffer timeout). Peer candidates (Actuator Sanitization, Phased Migration Orchestrator, Dependency Compatibility) operate at different stages/task families and do not subsume this prerequisite check.
